about: Every rebuild of the site from the FOCUS specification and every batch of AI-written text since 12 November 2026, newest first, with what each did and what it cost at list price. A summary that the first model fails the checks on twice is escalated to the fallback model (Claude Sonnet 5.5) for two more tries; each entry shows how many were. Summaries written before 12 November aren't listed.

runs.note: Before the Sonnet fallback was added: the 11 that failed were skipped.
Rebuilt locally: the history now follows renames without git log --follow.
